name: Tangerine Money-Back Credit Card

apr.notes: 20.95% purchase interest rate and 22.95% cash advance interest rate.

credit_required.notes: Gross annual income of $12,000 or more, at least the age of majority, a Canadian resident with no bankruptcy in the past 7 years.

categories.label: Two categories of your choice (third with savings account deposit), chosen from grocery, restaurants, gas, entertainment, furniture, hotel-motel, drug store, recurring bill payments, home improvement, public transportation and parking, fitness and sports clubs, e-games and foreign currency spend

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash back can be applied to your Credit Card against the balance owing, or deposited to your Tangerine Savings Account, which gives a third 2% category.

signup_bonus.description: Extra 10% cash back for 2 months, up to $100, on top of regular cash back.

notes: Categories can be changed every 90 days. The issuer page does not name a network package tier, so network_tier is none.
